title: Impulse Space hero
description: A full-window black hero filled edge to edge by one video or photo. A short centred title in 40px semibold sits near the foot (a little above the middle on phones), over a 400px hairline track with a small craft marker at its centre and an uppercase mono label for the featured vehicle beneath.
notes: sized by the window (100svh); the media is cropped like object-fit: cover
a .dark scope: always black with white text, whatever the page's mode
